title: Partner Schemes & Strategic Offers
tagline: Tailored incentive programmes designed to empower early-stage startups, agency partners, and high-volume merchants.
description: Whether you are bootstrapping a new brand, managing 50+ merchant client stores, or looking to maximize annual savings, explore our dedicated schemes below.

schemes.name: Startup Accelerator Scheme
schemes.tagline: 50% off all Yuvora apps for early-stage Shopify brands
schemes.description: We know the challenges of scaling an early DTC store. Get 50% off all Yuvora apps for 6 months to help you build momentum and maximize early conversion.
eligibility: Shopify store operational for under 12 months
benefits: 50% discount on all app tiers for 6 full months

schemes.name: Agency Partner Scheme
schemes.tagline: Co-marketing, complimentary staging licenses & 25% revenue share
schemes.description: Designed for Shopify agencies, freelance designers, and development studios building high-performance e-commerce experiences for their clients.
eligibility: Actively managing at least 3 Shopify client stores
Willingness to participate in joint case studies
benefits: 100% free app licenses on unlimited partner dev stores
25% lifetime recurring revenue share for every client referral
Early beta access to new Shopify Functions apps

schemes.name: Annual Prepay Scheme
schemes.tagline: Save 20% on any plan with annual billing + complimentary onboarding
schemes.description: Commit to annual growth and receive 2 full months free every year, plus a 1-on-1 concierge onboarding and installation session with our core engineering team.
eligibility: Available to all merchants on any plan
Billed upfront annually through Shopify App Billing
Stackable with annual Shopify Plus subscriptions
benefits: 2 months free every year (equivalent to 20% savings)
Quarterly health checks & feature optimization reviews
Guaranteed rate lock for up to 2 years
